description: Reads YOUR OWN app's indexed listing text -- name, subtitle and the keywords field -- from App Store Connect, per locale. This is the only way to see the keywords field: it is private to the developer and no public endpoint exposes it, so for anyone else's app it stays unavailable. Requires App Store Connect API credentials; without them the tool says so rather than failing. Use it before judging a keyword: coverage of a query's words across name+subtitle+keywords is what you can actually change.

app.description: Your app: a numeric App Store id, an App Store URL, or a bundle id. It must be an app your App Store Connect API key can see.

country.description: Two-letter storefront country code. Given, the response leads with the locale that storefront serves (and says so when the app has no localization for it and falls back). Omitted, every locale is returned.

name: my_listing
title: Your own App Store listing text
